verses.en: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
verses.sm: Farao i tagata 0 Isaraelu O igoa nei o atalii o Isaraelu e na o atu i Aikupito faatasi ma Iakopo, e taitasi ma lona aiga na O atu ai;

verses.en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.sm: o Reupena, o Simeona, o Levi, ma Iuta,

verses.en: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.sm: o Isakara, o Sepulona, ma Peniamina,

verses.en: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.sm: o Tanu, ma Nafatali, o Kato, ma Asera.

verses.en: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.
verses.sm: O tagata uma na fanaua e lakopo e toafitugafulu i latou, a o Iosefa sa i ai o ia i Aikupito.

verses.en: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
verses.sm: Ua oti foi Iosefa, ma ona uso uma, atoa ma lea lava tupulaga uma;

verses.en: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
verses.sm: a ua fanafanau le fanauga a Isaraelu, ua matuā faatoateleina, ua uluola, ma ua faasilisili ona toatele, ua tumu lava le nuu ia te i latou.

verses.en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
verses.sm: Ona nofo mai lea i le malo o Aikupito o le tupu fou na te lei iloa Iosefa.

verses.en: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
verses.sm: Ua ia fai atu i lona nuu, Faauta, o le nuu o le fanauga a Isaraelu ua sili ona toatele ma le malosi ia i tatou;

verses.en: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
verses.sm: ina o mai ia, ina tatou togafiti poto ia i latou, neʻi tupu tele, ona ju ai lea, pe a oo se taua, ina “au faatasi i latou ma e “ino'ino mai ia i tatou, ma latou tau mai ia i tatou, ma o ese i le nuu nei.

verses.en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
verses.sm: Ona latou tofia ai lea o e pule i galuega ia te i latou, ina ia latou faatiga ia te i latou i a latou avega mamafa; ua latou faia foi mo Farao o aai e tuu ai oloa, 0 Pitoma ma Ramese.

verses.en: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua latou faatiga ia i latou, ua atili ai ona faatoateleina, ua atili ai foi ona tutupu; ua atuatuvale i latou i le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
verses.sm: Ua faapologaina e Aikupito le fanauga a Isaraelu i le faasaua.

verses.en: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
verses.sm: Ua latou faafiufiu foi ia i latou i le galuega mamafa, i le omea, ma maaomea, ma galuega uma i fanua; o a latou galuega uma lava na latou faapologaina ai i latou, ua faia ma le faasaua.

verses.en: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi le tupu o Aikupito i e na faatosaga i fanauga o fafine Eperu, o le igoa o le tasi o Sepela, o le igoa foi o le tasi o Puía,

verses.en: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
verses.sm: ua faapea atu, Pe a oulua faatosaga i fanauga o fafine Eperu, a oo ina a fanau, afai o se tama ia fasioti ia te ia, a e afai o se teine ia ola ia.

verses.en: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
verses.sm: A ua matatau i le Atua e na faatosaga i fanauga, e lei faia foi le mea na fai atu ai le tupu o Aikupito ia te i laua, a ua la faaola lava i tama tane.

verses.en: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
verses.sm: Ona aami atu lea e le tupu o Aikupito e na faatosaga i fanauga, ma fai atu: ia te i laua, Se a ea le mea ua oulua fai ai lenei mea ina ua lua faaolaina o tama tane?

verses.en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea e na faatosaga i fanauga ia Farao, Aua e le pei o fafine o Aikupito o fafine Eperu; aua e malolosi lava i latou, ua uma ona latou fanau mai, a O lei oo atu ai lava le faatosaga i fánauga.

verses.en: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
verses.sm: Ua agalelei le Atua i e na faatosaga i fánauga; ua faatoateleina le nuu, ua malolosi lava i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
verses.sm: Ua matatau i le Atua e na faatosaga i fanauga, o le mea lea na ia fai ai aiga mo i laua.

verses.en: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Farao i lona nuu uma lava, o loo faapea atu, O tama uma lava e fanau mai ia outou lafo i le vaitafe, a o teine uma lava ia outou faaolaina.
